builder_note: a development tool: the reviewed pack is the committed folder validation/caepipe_sitting_pack; regenerating it is a consistency test, not the trust anchor

items.observe: B. the batch sample (sample-dyn-batch), whose file carries the dynamics options record (OPMISC, with a number of modes) and the spectrum table: whether its print lists modes, and the section titles it holds

dry_run_checks: C. after the import in the window sample's folder, whether the import wrote a model file, and where (the export page, CAEPIPE-EXPORT-MBF, says "But note that the existing .mod file will be overwritten. So, you must rename the edited text file before importing it back into CAEPIPE." and does not say in which folder)
(i) compare the spectrum table the program shows with the stated values, and note agree or not
(ii) compare the Dynamics tab's Cutoff Frequency and Number of Modes with the stated values, and note agree or not; if the window shows the file's value in another unit, note that once
(iii) write down the command that saved the imported model; whether the program let you choose the name and the folder; the name and folder the saved file took; whether the program asked anything
(iv) note what the spectrum options window (Options > Spectrum) offers for axis units and interpolation

stated_values.cutoff_unit: The vendor's public import page gives the file's cutoff frequency value no unit; Hertz is taken from the analysis page's description of the window's Cutoff Frequency field.

spectrum.name: DYNFLAT
spectrum.units_as_read: the file's unit codes are 0 for the abscissa and 3 for the ordinate, which the benchmark manifest reads, by inference, as frequency (Hz) and acceleration (mm/sec2)

dry_run_checks: (v) step 3, before touching the dialog, the files the folder now holds, by name
(v) step 5, whether the dialog lets you set the name sample-dyn-export-trial.export.mbf and this folder, and whether it displays them before anything is written
(v) step 6, Export or Cancel ("If it does, click Export; if not, click Cancel")
(v) step 7, the files the folder then holds, by name
items.observe: check (v) of the dry run, in this folder only (INSTRUCTIONS.md section 4, step 6)
items.results_first: the model file the import writes, if it writes one (answer C)

items.not_held_equal: The support's load is an input NOT held equal, named constant_support_load: SWBPIPE states it (3|w|L/8), the target program's window calculates it by its own procedure. SWBPIPE's stated load is never adjusted to what comes back

parts.buys: Three small first-tranche cases taken through the batch route one line at a time, with your own comparison of the first print's section titles with the short list, and three copies of one dynamics run file: one run by the batch command, one opened in the program's window for the observations the benchmark manifest lists, and a sacrificial duplicate on which the export is tried (check (v)). By the benchmark manifest's consequences, its answers decide how parts 1 and 4 are run.
parts.title: Dry run

parts.buys: The modal and response-spectrum runs of tranche 3, in the benchmark manifest's strike order. Each pair has two forms, each in its own folder, and one case is declared in one form only; every case of this part is run in the program's window only.
parts.title: Dynamics runs

parts.buys: The declared screened runs of the cases that carry the exact pressure contract, each model's pressure-default run next to its pressure-elongation-on run, then the declared capture-only runs (pressure-bourdon-expansion-capture), which are sealed captures.
parts.title: Pressurised series

parts.buys: The three linear static one-parameter series of tranche 3: transverse shear in straight pipe (S1), shear and flexibility in a bend (S2) and the finite stiffness of a rigid support (S3), each series' members together.
parts.title: Series S1, S2 and S3

parts.buys: The five cases whose one support member is entered by hand on a written base, in the benchmark manifest's rank order, in the program's window only.
parts.title: Hand-entry cases

parts.buys: The first tranche's other models, by family, the members of one series next to each other and smaller models first.
parts.title: Tranche 1 remainder
